title: Remote-first support creates another delay
trigger: An authorized operator accepts a relevant request or scheduled obligation into the shared workflow.
preconditions: Ask connectivity, authorization and symptom questions first; agree a limited remote attempt and a clear escalation point.
Verify customer-specific permissions, identities, rules and system integration support.

business_rules.statement: Do not initiate control without applicable authorization.
business_rules.rationale: There is no eligibility gate or structured handover for remote support.

business_rules.statement: Disconnected or obvious physical faults may bypass remote support.

business_rules.statement: Time-box is configured with the service owner, not invented by the model.

acceptance_scenarios.scenario_and_expected_result: An offline PC goes to alternative triage without repeated connection attempts.
A failed attempt carries diagnostic notes into dispatch.

human_review: Approved tools, access policies and practical time-box thresholds need local validation.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Remote eligibility logic is new; remote-control software itself is not provided.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
